company_news.headline: Quantum computing is helping AT&T solve network problems in seconds: D-Wave CEO
company_news.summary: D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) has transferred its listing on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) to the Nasdaq (^IXIC). The quantum computing company has also expanded its network optimization deal with AT&T (T). D-Wave Quantum CEO and president Alan Baratz sits down with Julie Hyman to talk more about its optimization goals for AT&T and other clients.

company_news.headline: AT&T (T) Expands D Wave Partnership To Rework Telecom Network Operations
company_news.summary: AT&T (NYSE:T) has expanded its quantum computing partnership with D-Wave to cover more of its telecom network operations. The agreement focuses on applying quantum tools to outage detection, technician routing, and traffic management across AT&T's network. The move shifts the collaboration from limited pilots to wider operational use within AT&T's infrastructure.
